head: a84f8fa6b0aefa0b3c65a2c924e28ca2492a591c
summary: I reworded only the WindowScriptParseTests class summary, as the send-back asked. It no longer says the parse check 'covers code and string literals'. It now says the parse check catches only non-ASCII that 5.1 decodes into a quote character. A curly quote or dash in a double-quoted string gave two errors. An e-acute in the same place gave none, and a curly quote or dash in a comment gave none either. WindowCasesIsAscii guards every byte. No code changed. The file is still ASCII with CRLF line endings, and the class passes 3/3.

obligations.how: Owed to validate-slice, not to this build, and unchanged. It needs a second sign-in session, which no engine stage can create. Per the send-back, it is for the owner to carry to the person-run SMB-LOOPBACK pass ('not now'). Nothing in this build addresses it.
